name: print-social-teal-creative-marketing-agency-post-with-ok-gesture
title: Teal 'We are Creative Marketing Agency' post with a translucent rounded panel and an excited man giving OK
whatItIs: A square light grey post with an excited man in glasses and a teal sweater making an OK sign, a translucent teal rounded-square panel overlapping his hand with script 'we are' and bold white 'CREATIVE MARKETING AGENCY', a teal 'Contact us' button, phone and website details.
whatItMeans: Upbeat and approachable; the translucent panel lets his gesture show through, linking person and message.
techniques: Overlap a translucent panel over the subject's gesture.
Match the sweater to the brand colour.
Pair a script lead-in with bold caps.

vocabulary.definition: A see-through shape over an image.
A hand sign that adds meaning.
